business_summary: Guangdong Champion Asia Electronics Co.,Ltd. develops, manufactures, and sells printed circuit boards (PCBs) and surface mount technology (SMT) in the People's Republic of China. The company provides rigid circuit boards, flexible circuit boards, rigid-flex circuit boards, high-density interconnect circuit boards, and PCBAs. Its products are primarily used in consumer electronics, car electronics, IT communication, industrial control, security, new energy, computer and network equipment, automotive electronics, security electronics, and aerospace sectors. Guangdong Champion Asia Electronics Co.,Ltd. was founded in 2005 and is based in Huizhou, the People's Republic of China.
